rules.rule: The sign effects described for the Moon apply also to the rising sign and to the 2nd, 3rd and other bhavas, when the house and its lord are powerful
If the Moon, her sign and that sign's lord all be powerful, the sign effects come fully; two powerful = imperfectly; one = still less; none = fail. The same grading applies to the other planets
